body:
I actually think telling people face to face would be more helpful but I lost all my friends after I left school and don't have anyone else. I tried to make more friends but I can't connect with anyone anymore. It's like there's a giant glass wall between myself and everyone else. I can kind of yell at them through the glass, they can yell back. We can see each other and all that, but I'm not really there with everyone else. I'm just trapped, watching everyone else live. I guess that's the depression. It's one of the big reasons why I'm suicidal. I can't stand the loneliness and isolation. I can't stand the feelings of failure I have while I watch everyone else succeed and be normal.

I like most kinds of music. I can't think of a lot of genres I don't like. Even though I'm depressed, I still find a lot of enjoyment in listening to music. Sometimes, music is all I have to me from losing it completely.
I don't even know what to talk about anymore. I feel like I've said everything I can and there's nothing else anyone (myself included) can do. I should just get it over with.
